name: Theme editor
author: Brett
description: Edit colour and style themes token by token. A Colour section and a Style section, each collapsible, with collapsible categories listing every token the asset types and known themes have (new tokens show up by themselves). Copy a theme, save it as a standard asset@1 theme, load any theme; edits preview live and apply through the hub look, so every app follows. Toolbar views: tree, grid, swatches, compare. Uses the Theme manager's token tree (axf.token-tree@1). Nav → Plugins → Theme editor; Settings → Plugins → Theme editor.
